correctness.rationale: Cobalancing normalization b_n=2u_n gives u_{n+2}=6u_{n+1}-u_n+1 and a_n=u_n². Sliding differences reduce infinite window GCD to gcd(initial sum, gcd of differences). Pell addition and the monic unit-constant fourth-order recurrence reduce the latter to first four factors f_t or h_t, yielding D_k with exact small 2/7 corrections. Pell sum telescoping gives 64S_k(0)=P_k Q_k(Q_{2k}-8)+5k; the modulo-D congruence determines odd-prime gcd valuations. The dyadic block shift congruence and square-sum recurrence prove exact remaining two-adic exponent. Independent integer check for all k=1..120 found agreement with GCD over nine shifts; the symbolic recurrence proves the infinite n condition, not this bounded calculation.
